new_page.h1: Metrotown Houses for Sale | Burnaby Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Metrotown. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Metrotown, Burnaby: 15 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 14 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Metrotown fell from 17 in June to 15 in October (−11.8%), and 17 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 3.5% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Metrotown?
Metrotown also had 345 condos and townhomes listed and 35 sold in October, against 15 houses listed. The Metrotown condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Metrotown home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 houses sold in Metrotown with a median price of $1,950,000 (the middle half sold between $1,873,250 and $2,384,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 92.3% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $660 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 7,326 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Metrotown?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed in Metrotown. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Metrotown a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Metrotown had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Metrotown from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 17 houses sold in Metrotown over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Metrotown?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Metrotown sell for?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in Metrotown between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,950,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Metrotown?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 92.3% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
